title: Keynote Presentation: Copper Market Outlook: Supply and Demand Dynamics
gist: Member-only video page for a Giga Africa 2026 keynote on copper supply and demand, presented by Trafigura's Henry Van and Benchmark's Shruti Kashyap; the text holds only session titles and no copper data or argument. The surrounding agenda shows the conference's focus on copper, graphite, lithium and LFP batteries in Africa.

insights.claim: Trafigura's head of industrial metal analysis, Henry Van, and Benchmark Mineral Intelligence's head of consulting, Shruti Kashyap, delivered a keynote on copper market supply and demand dynamics at Giga Africa 2026; the page text gives no figures or conclusions, as the content is member-only.
insights.speaker: Henry Van , Head of Industrial Metal Analysis , Trafigura; Shruti Kashyap , Head of Consulting , Benchmark Mineral Intel
insights.so_what: No copper view can be extracted here; the full video would be needed for supply/demand signal.

insights.claim: The Giga Africa 2026 programme pairs commodity updates on copper and graphite with sessions on African battery storage pipelines, OEM and EV adoption, and lithium supply chains, indicating battery-metals value chain development in Africa is a central conference theme.
insights.speaker: Henry Van , Head of Industrial Metal Analysis , Trafigura; Shruti Kashyap , Head of Consulting , Benchmark Mineral Intel
insights.so_what: Watch for African battery-materials project and investment announcements tied to this event.

insights.claim: One Giga Africa 2026 keynote asks whether the time is right for an integrated LFP battery supply chain in Africa, and a panel examines what it takes to build graphite and anode capacity outside China.
insights.speaker: Henry Van , Head of Industrial Metal Analysis , Trafigura; Shruti Kashyap , Head of Consulting , Benchmark Mineral Intel
insights.so_what: Signals interest in diversifying battery supply chains away from China; track non-China graphite and LFP projects.
